tasks.goal: Build a zero-dependency Node JSON API in server.js with POST /labels accepting {"name": string, "color": "#RRGGBB"} and GET /labels listing created labels. Reject blank names, wrong types, and malformed colors with status 400. Bind process.env.PORT and emit LISTENING_ON_PORT=<N>. Add README.md using only <port> placeholders in durable URLs and startup markers. In a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, mechanically probe the empty list, valid creation/listing, blank name, wrong type, and malformed color.
